description: Call this right before your agent tries to check out at a store, or when a user asks "can my agent check out at <store>?". Not for an attempt that already happened (log it with report_outcome), the reason an agent keeps failing (why_blocked_and_fix), or choosing between 2 or more stores (compare). Returns a one-line answer, reaches_checkout (true only when a checkout link came back or a shopper reached checkout; false when a route was measured and did not reach checkout; null when not shown either way: no agent catalog found and no browser test is null, and so is a product added to the cart with no shopper reaching checkout; null is not a no), protocol_route, browser_route, standard_shoppers when ARC's standard shoppers tried the store (a dated label, "ARC's standard shoppers: N of M reached checkout, <date>": a lower bound, not a verdict; ARC stops before payment and never places an order), best_route (the best saved way in), payment_methods_declared (the payment handler ids the store declares to agents in its own UCP profile, with source "ucp_profile", checked_at and a note; the store's own declaration, not a test of any agent paying there; null with payment_methods_note when ARC has no UCP profile reading, which is not a no), up to 3 blockers, checked_at, the Agent Readiness Grade (grade, with expired when over 30 days old; grade_note when not graded, which is not a mark against the store), alternatives_hint when the grade is D or F or expired (a find_stores call with min_grade B in the same category), and a full_record link. Example: before_checkout({"url":"https://allbirds.com"}) → {"answer":"A saved check got a checkout link back at allbirds.com via storefront_mcp (6 hours ago).","reaches_checkout":true,…}. The answer leads with the dated fact; once the record is not current it starts "Last known on <date>.". reaches_checkout false or unknown is not a no. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

url.description: Store or product URL, such as https://allbirds.com or allbirds.com.
